scripts.create-aws-key:cf: set -a; . ../.env; set +a; aws secretsmanager create-secret --name "$CF_PRIVATE_KEY_SECRET_NAME" --description "Cloudfront Private Key (bookgenius)" --secret-string "file://$PRIVATE_CF_KEY_NAME"  --region "$AWS_REGION" --no-cli-pager
scripts.create-aws-key:jwt: set -a; . ../.env; set +a; aws secretsmanager create-secret --name "$JWT_PRIVATE_KEY_SECRET_NAME" --description "JWT Private Key (bookgenius)" --secret-string "file://$PRIVATE_JWT_KEY_NAME"  --region "$AWS_REGION" --no-cli-pager
scripts.generate-key:cf: set -a; . ../.env; set +a; p="${PRIVATE_CF_KEY_NAME:-private-cf-key.pem}";  pub="${PUBLIC_CF_KEY_NAME:-public-cf-key.pem}";   openssl genrsa -out "$p" 2048 && openssl rsa -in "$p" -pubout -out "$pub"
scripts.generate-key:jwt: set -a; . ../.env; set +a; p="${PRIVATE_JWT_KEY_NAME:-private-jwt-key.pem}"; pub="${PUBLIC_JWT_KEY_NAME:-public-jwt-key.pem}"; openssl genrsa -out "$p" 2048 && openssl rsa -in "$p" -pubout -out "$pub"
